description: Keyless retail and technical-community discussion for a name or theme, from Reddit (searched inside the equity subreddits, not site-wide), Hacker News, and any Bluesky handles supplied. IMPORTANT: X / Twitter has NO free discovery channel -- Nitter search is dead, the X API bills per post and xAI bills per call -- so this does NOT cover professional FinTwit, and Reddit is not a substitute for it. Mention volume measures attention, never correctness. Nothing here may enter a conclusion alone; it is a lead to be confirmed against a filing or recorded in open_questions.

days.description: Recency window in days. Defaults to 7.

handles.description: Bluesky handles to read. Search needs auth; reading a named account does not.

query.description: Company name or theme to search for.

symbol.description: Used as the query when query is absent.
